iterations.plan: Implement frame-by-frame scoring with bounds checking for bonuses, accounting for the house rule in the tenth frame.
iterations.code:
def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    i = 0  # index in rolls
    for frame in range(1, 11):
        if frame < 10:
            # Strike case
            if rolls[i] == 10:
                score += 10
                # Add next two rolls if they exist
                if i + 1 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[i + 1]
                if i + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[i + 2]
                i += 1
            else:
                # Two rolls for this frame
                first = rolls[i]
                second = rolls[i + 1]
                frame_sum = first + second
                if frame_sum == 10:  # spare
                    score += 10
                    if i + 2 < len(rolls):
                        score += rolls[i + 2]
                else:  # open frame
                    score += frame_sum
                i += 2
        else:  # 10th frame
            # Strike: only the strike roll counts
            if rolls[i] == 10:
                score += 10
                i += 1
            else:
                # Two rolls for the last frame
                score += rolls[i] + rolls[i + 1]
                i += 2
    return score
